snippet.title: 「MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA」Main Trailer
snippet.description:
MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA is back and better than ever!
Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray!

A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

■PRODUCT INFO
Title：MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA
Genre：2D fighter
Platforms：PlayStation®5 / PlayStation®4 / Nintendo Switch™ 2 / Nintendo Switch™ / Xbox One / Steam®
Players：1–2 (supports online play)
Release Date：April 22, 2027
Supported Languages：Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish, French, Portuguese　*Voiceover available in Japanese only.
ESRB：TEEN
Creator：Kinoko Nasu / TYPE-MOON
Developer：FRENCH-BREAD
Publisher：Aniplex of America

Official Website：http://meltyblood.twilumina-en.com/?utm_source=media&utm_campaign=evj_26
Official Social Media：X / Instagram：@MB_Lumina_EN ｜ Facebook：MB.Lumina.EN

Store：
・PlayStation™Store：https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012838
・Xbox One：https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mvp487kvwwh
・Steam®：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113000/MELTY_BLOOD_TWILUMINA/
